title: epan: Convert to use stdio.h from GLib
description:
Replace:
    g_snprintf() -> snprintf()
    g_vsnprintf() -> vsnprintf()
    g_strdup_printf() -> ws_strdup_printf()
    g_strdup_vprintf() -> ws_strdup_vprintf()

This is more portable, user-friendly and faster on platforms
where GLib does not like the native I/O.

Adjust the format string to use macros from intypes.h.

notes.body:
added 3 commits
  • 70d3a673...737d1dc1 - 2 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • c5a19582 - epan: Convert to use stdio.h from GLib
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/5498/diffs?diff_id=298880216&start_sha=70d3a673465d8132a3aecef1c8920e60ef5410f2)
Isn't the correct macro `SCNx64` for use with `sscanf()`?
Yes, my mistake, I should have double checked this. I will push a fix, thanks.
